payoutCycle.description: FundingPips ties your profit split to a reward cycle you lock in before your first trade: weekly "Tuesday Payday" (60% split), bi-weekly (80%, the default), monthly (100%), or on-demand (90%, capped at 35% of profit from any single day). The first weekly payout is available after 5 trading days; other cycles follow their own schedule from there.

faqs.question: What is FundingPips?
faqs.answer: FundingPips is a proprietary trading firm founded in November 2022 and headquartered in Dubai, UAE. It offers 1-Step, 2-Step, Zero and PRIME evaluation models on accounts from $5,000 to $300,000, with scaling up to $2,000,000, and has paid out more than $267 million to funded traders as of 2026.

seo.title: What is FundingPips? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundingPips is a Dubai-based prop firm founded in 2022, offering 1-Step, 2-Step, Zero and PRIME funded accounts.

faqs.question: How does the FundingPips profit split work?
faqs.answer: Unlike firms with one fixed split, FundingPips ties your profit share to the reward cycle you choose before your first trade: 60% for weekly payouts, 80% for bi-weekly (the most common default), 90% for on-demand withdrawals, and 100% for a monthly cycle. This choice is locked in once selected, so pick the cycle that matches how often you want to cash out.

seo.title: FundingPips Profit Split by Payout Cycle | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundingPips pays 60% weekly, 80% bi-weekly, 90% on-demand, or 100% monthly, depending on the cycle you select at signup.

faqs.question: When can I request my first FundingPips withdrawal?
faqs.answer: Weekly-cycle accounts pay out every Tuesday, with withdrawals opening after 5 trading days. Bi-weekly, monthly and on-demand cycles follow their own respective schedules. Every request needs at least 1% net profit on the initial balance, and Master accounts are set to view-only while a payout is being processed.

seo.title: FundingPips Payout Cycle and First Withdrawal | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundingPips' Tuesday Payday opens after 5 trading days; every cycle requires at least 1% net profit to request a payout.

faqs.question: What withdrawal methods and fees does FundingPips use?
faqs.answer: Payouts are available via cryptocurrency (USDT/USDC, fastest and no fixed minimum), the Rise platform (bank or crypto, $500 minimum, requires KYC), or a direct bank wire ($500 minimum). FundingPips applies a flat $10 processing fee per withdrawal; crypto network fees and bank intermediary charges are separate and outside the firm's control.

seo.title: FundingPips Withdrawal Methods and $10 Fee | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundingPips charges a flat $10 processing fee across crypto, Rise and bank wire payouts, each with its own minimum.

faqs.question: How does the FundingPips PRIME scaling plan work?
faqs.answer: PRIME is unlocked after your 3rd reward cycle (or by invitation) and scales your account by 10% every time you hit a profit milestone: +5% cumulative profit for Levels 1–4, then +10% per level after that. Scaling never resets when you withdraw. Reaching Hot Seat (Elite) status after 16 rewards and 40% cumulative profit doubles your original balance and raises your split to 100%, up to a $2,000,000 ceiling.
